findings.body: The single `roots` dictionary keeps only the first assignment to each variable name across the entire file. For example, if one test sets `root = Path(__file__).parent / 'fixtures'` and another sets `root = Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'docs'` before reading `(root / 'guide.md').read_text()`, the second binding is discarded. The reader is then matched against `fixtures/guide.md`, so changing `docs/guide.md` still skips CI and omits the consuming test from pytest selection. This uses a literal filename, unlike the accepted separate-filename-variable limitation. Track bindings per scope or conservatively retain alternative roots; the copied implementation in `.forge/review-tests.py` needs the same correction.
